# Shivansh Properties

> Family-run property consultancy in Noida, Uttar Pradesh, India. Started in 2011 by the
> father of Mukul Kaushik, who runs it today. One office handling every kind of property
> work in Noida — buying, selling, renting and leasing — for buyers and sellers, owners and
> tenants alike. Best known for cafe and restaurant spaces: most of the cafes on Roastery
> Street, the cafe lane in Sector 144, found their space through Shivansh Properties.

## Business facts

- Name: Shivansh Properties
- Tagline: Building Trust. Creating Futures.
- Founded: 2011, family run
- Run by: Mukul Kaushik
- Office: CM-52, Sector 144, Noida, Uttar Pradesh 201306, India
- Phone and WhatsApp: +91 99115 59688
- Website: https://shivanshproperties.com
- Primary area: Noida, all sectors
- Focus sectors: 99, 105, 108, 130, 132, 135, 141, 143, 144, 145, 151 — all on the Noida–Greater Noida Expressway
- Also serves: Greater Noida, YEIDA, Delhi NCR
- Works both sides of every deal: buyers and sellers, owners and tenants, landlords and occupiers

## Services

- [Buying Property in Noida](https://shivanshproperties.com/services/buy-property-noida): Flats, kothis and plots — our main work. Real prices, checked papers.
- [Selling Property in Noida](https://shivanshproperties.com/services/sell-property-noida): Priced against real closings, shown to real buyers, closed properly.
- [Renting a Home in Noida](https://shivanshproperties.com/services/residential-renting-noida): Finding tenants for owners. Finding homes for tenants. Paperwork done properly.
- [Commercial Leasing in Noida](https://shivanshproperties.com/services/commercial-leasing-noida): Office floors, shops, corporate and IT park space along the Expressway.
- [Buying & Selling Commercial Space](https://shivanshproperties.com/services/commercial-buy-sell-noida): Offices, shops and commercial units bought and sold — yield, tenant and exit.
- [Industrial Space in Noida](https://shivanshproperties.com/services/industrial-spaces-noida): Lease and sale of industrial units across Noida's industrial belts.
- [PG Buildings in Noida](https://shivanshproperties.com/services/pg-spaces-noida): Owners with large spaces on one side, PG operators on the other. We sit in the middle.
- [Cafe & Restaurant Space in Noida](https://shivanshproperties.com/services/cafe-restaurant-spaces-noida): From finding the space to opening day. Our strongest work — ask about Roastery Street.
- [Corporate & Brand Requirements](https://shivanshproperties.com/services/corporate-brand-requirements-noida): Banks opening branches, quick-commerce hubs, chains entering Noida — we find the site.

## Noida sectors covered in detail

- [Sector 99, Noida](https://shivanshproperties.com/sectors/sector-99-noida): Buying, selling or renting in Sector 99, Noida. Authority flats, HIG blocks, kothis and builder floors — resale advice from a dealer working the sector since 2011.
- [Sector 105, Noida](https://shivanshproperties.com/sectors/sector-105-noida): Kothis, villas and plots in Sector 105, Noida. A premium plotted belt near the Expressway — honest rates and quiet listings from a local dealer since 2011.
- [Sector 108, Noida](https://shivanshproperties.com/sectors/sector-108-noida): Kothis, villas, duplexes and plots in Sector 108, Noida, plus Parx Laureate and Divine Meadows. Local dealer working the sector since 2011.
- [Sector 130, Noida](https://shivanshproperties.com/sectors/sector-130-noida): Plots and premium homes in Sector 130, Noida — the Expressway pocket beside the Wish Town belt, with rental demand from the nearby office parks.
- [Sector 132, Noida](https://shivanshproperties.com/sectors/sector-132-noida): Office space and high-street retail in Sector 132, Noida — Express Trade Tower 2, Matrix Tower, Logix Technova, Digital Park and Grand Street.
- [Sector 135, Noida](https://shivanshproperties.com/sectors/sector-135-noida): Office space and homes in Sector 135, Noida — Candor TechSpace, Stellar IT Park, Assotech Business Cresterra, plus villas, high-rises and plotted housing.
- [Sector 141, Noida](https://shivanshproperties.com/sectors/sector-141-noida): Plots and rentals in Sector 141, Noida — a quieter mixed sector next to commercial 142 and Advant Navis, with less competition and fair value.
- [Sector 143, Noida](https://shivanshproperties.com/sectors/sector-143-noida): Flats to buy and rent in Sector 143, Noida — Logix Blossom, Gulshan Ikebana, Sikka Kaamna Greens and more, with its own Aqua Line metro station.
- [Sector 144, Noida](https://shivanshproperties.com/sectors/sector-144-noida): Our home sector. Cafes on Roastery Street, Embassy Oxygen Business Park, its own metro station — and our office at CM-52, Sector 144, Noida.
- [Sector 145, Noida](https://shivanshproperties.com/sectors/sector-145-noida): Abadi plots and new launches in Sector 145, Noida — the emerging SEZ side, one metro stop from 144, with its own station on the Aqua Line.
- [Sector 151, Noida](https://shivanshproperties.com/sectors/sector-151-noida): Sector 151, Noida — farm plots, Experion Saatori and the new frontier of the Expressway, near the 147 and 148 metro stations and the airport side.

## Guides

Process explained in plain English. These deliberately avoid quoting tax rates, fees or
charges as current facts, because those change — they say where to confirm the number.

- [Stamp duty and registration in Noida — how it works](https://shivanshproperties.com/guides/stamp-duty-registration-noida): What the duty is charged on, what happens at the sub-registrar, and what to budget for.
- [How to verify property documents in UP before buying](https://shivanshproperties.com/guides/verify-property-documents-up): Title chain, mutation, dues, approvals — the checks to make before money moves.
- [Selling your property in Noida — the full process](https://shivanshproperties.com/guides/selling-property-noida-process): Pricing, paperwork, real buyers, dues, registration — the whole sequence.
- [Circle rates in Noida — what they are and why they matter](https://shivanshproperties.com/guides/circle-rates-noida): The government's minimum value — and why it can cost you more than you expect.
- [Leasehold, freehold and Noida Authority transfer](https://shivanshproperties.com/guides/leasehold-freehold-noida-authority-transfer): Why Noida has an extra step in every deal, and how to plan the timeline around it.
- [Commercial lease basics — the terms worth arguing about](https://shivanshproperties.com/guides/commercial-lease-basics): Maintenance, escalation, lock-in, fit-out, deposit — where the money really is.
- [Opening a cafe or restaurant in Noida](https://shivanshproperties.com/guides/open-cafe-restaurant-noida): Location, the physical checks, the approvals, and the lease terms to push on.
- [Renting out a flat in Noida — the process](https://shivanshproperties.com/guides/rent-out-flat-noida): Rent, preparation, tenant checks, the agreement, and a handover that avoids arguments.
